notes.title: Update 0.1.6
notes.content:
Hey fellow orcs,

I've released two new updates 0.1.5 and 0.1.6 for the free demo here on Steam, which consist of a bunch of fixes and also some minor balancing. Especially a bug where customers weren't able to visit the inn is now gone. You can also place a guidepost near the map's border and mark it as owned. Customers will then enter the map there from now on. The full changelogs for [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/533800/discussions/0/154642901282088597/#c144512942751859539]0.1.5[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/533800/discussions/0/154642901282088597/#c144512942755481812]0.1.6[/url] are available in the forums.

As already announced, Orcish Inn's development isn't funded, so I'm going on a (hopefully) short break for the coming weeks. I will keep you up-to-date on [url=http://twitter.com/StevenColling]Twitter[/url] when I have something to show for you! :)

If you have feedback, questions or found any bugs or problems, I'm still around in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/533800/discussions/]forums[/url]. Thank you for playing Orcish Inn and your patience!

Best wishes,
Steven
